module_summary: Synchronous FIFO with dual-port handshake: tracks fill level from head/tail pointers via controller, stores data in register bank, gates write/read via control flags.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Input valid signal indicating data available to write.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Output ready signal indicating FIFO not full.

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: 32-bit input data payload written to FIFO.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Output valid signal indicating data available to read.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Input ready signal indicating receiver ready to accept.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: 32-bit output data payload read from FIFO.

anchors.name: lvl
anchors.why: Current fill level computed from head/tail pointers.

anchors.name: count_o
anchors.why: Occupancy count output to external observers.

anchors.name: give
anchors.why: Write enable signal gating data into storage.

anchors.name: take
anchors.why: Read enable signal gating data out of storage.

anchors.name: brim
anchors.why: Full flag indicating FIFO at capacity.

anchors.name: dry
anchors.why: Empty flag indicating FIFO has no data.

anchors.name: rd_at
anchors.why: Read address pointer to next data element.

anchors.name: wr_at
anchors.why: Write address pointer to next storage location.

groups.name: Input Handshake
groups.description: Valid, ready, and data signals for FIFO write port.

groups.name: Output Handshake
groups.description: Valid, ready, and data signals for FIFO read port.

groups.name: Fill Level Tracking
groups.description: Occupancy level updated by head/tail pointer controller.

groups.name: Control Flags
groups.description: Enable and status flags gating storage operations.

groups.name: Address Pointers
groups.description: Read and write address indices into storage bank.

groups.name: Storage
groups.description: Register file bank holding FIFO data.
